# v1.0.5 · Takes turns

### Fixed

- **Takes turns on the keyboard.** The keyboard has one file buffer shared by every program. TrackDeck now shares one lock with DeckMapper, SlotDeck and Admiral, so writing the card can never land in the middle of another program's write.
- **Two programs starting together could share a session.** They now start their sessions one after the other.

**Full changelog:** [v1.0.4...v1.0.5](https://github.com/yourgirljolyne/TrackDeck/compare/v1.0.4...v1.0.5)
